risks.risk: Tip-over when a child climbs or pulls on the top
risks.mitigation: Wide base, low centre of mass, wall anti-tip strap supplied and required in the manual

risks.risk: Baby rolls off the changing surface
risks.mitigation: Raised barriers on all sides of the changing area (height per EN 12221-1 / ASTM F2388, to be confirmed)

risks.risk: Finger and head entrapment in gaps and hinges
risks.mitigation: Keep gaps < 5 mm or > 12 mm (fingers); no V-shaped openings; soft-close hinges

risks.risk: Small parts and choking (knobs, activity beads)
risks.mitigation: Small-parts cylinder test; captive fasteners; no detachable caps

risks.risk: Coatings with lead or heavy metals
risks.mitigation: EN 71-3 / CPSIA compliant water-based finishes, lab reports per colour

tests.name: Stability / tip-over (loaded and unloaded, drawers open)

assembly_steps: Cut plywood panels on a CNC router from the CAD outlines
Dry-fit, then glue and screw with the production fasteners
Apply an EN 71-3 compliant water-based finish
Run an in-house tip test: incline and horizontal push at the top edge
Book a pre-test at an accredited nursery-furniture lab
